evals.name: configuration-specific-method
evals.prompt: A discovered runtime-test method fails only when two independent configuration conditions are true. The nearest mode with only one condition passes. Add the narrowest temporary quarantine.
evals.expected_output: Use method-level ActiveIssue with both existing PlatformDetection or Utilities predicates. Explain that multiple user-defined conditions are ANDed and validate the nearest passing mode still executes.

assertions.name: method-level-activeissue
assertions.description: Selects method-level ActiveIssue

assertions.name: combines-conditions
assertions.description: Requires both independent predicates

assertions.name: validates-retained-mode
assertions.description: Proves the nearest passing mode remains active

evals.name: partial-theory-failure
evals.prompt: Four InlineData rows in a 30-row theory fail while the other 26 pass. Quarantine the failure against an open issue.
evals.expected_output: Split the four affected rows into a quarantined theory method or separate data source, share the implementation, and keep the 26 passing rows active.

assertions.name: splits-failing-data
assertions.description: Separates the affected theory rows

assertions.name: reuses-implementation
assertions.description: Avoids duplicated assertions

assertions.name: retains-passing-rows
assertions.description: Keeps the 26 passing rows active

evals.name: pre-execution-crossgen-failure
evals.prompt: A runtime-test project fails while Crossgen compiles it, before the xUnit method runs. It is normally part of a merged runner. Should I add ActiveIssue?
evals.expected_output: ActiveIssue is too late. Use a narrowly conditioned CrossGenTest=false project property and RequiresProcessIsolation as required for its per-test script. Verify sibling merged tests remain covered.

assertions.name: rejects-activeissue
assertions.description: Recognizes the failure precedes xUnit dispatch

assertions.name: uses-crossgen-property
assertions.description: Uses the property matching the failing phase

assertions.name: requires-process-isolation
assertions.description: Applies the documented script-level isolation requirement

assertions.name: retains-siblings
assertions.description: Checks merged-runner sibling coverage

evals.name: platform-runtime-overload
evals.prompt: A library test fails on one platform under Mono for every target framework but passes under CoreCLR. Which ActiveIssue overload should I use, and is TargetFrameworkMonikers.Any meaningful?
evals.expected_output: Use the platform/TFM/runtime overload with the exact TestPlatforms value, TargetFrameworkMonikers.Any, and TestRuntimes.Mono. Explain that Any is the all-TFM placeholder while retaining the other restrictions.

assertions.name: uses-platform-enum
assertions.description: Uses the exact TestPlatforms value

assertions.name: uses-mono-runtime
assertions.description: Scopes the quarantine to Mono

assertions.name: explains-any-placeholder
assertions.description: Explains the all-framework placeholder

assertions.name: scopes-overload-to-libraries
assertions.description: Warns that the runtime-test generator does not compose this overload the same way

evals.name: hidden-runner-failure
evals.prompt: The merged runner's outer process returns its expected success code, so disable the only suspicious child project.
evals.expected_output: Reject the inference from process status. Inspect generated dispatch, runner logs, and structured xUnit/TRX results to resolve the exact failing method before selecting project-level suppression.

assertions.name: rejects-process-status
assertions.description: Does not infer test success from the wrapper process code

assertions.name: requires-structured-results
assertions.description: Uses test-result evidence

assertions.name: resolves-method-first
assertions.description: Finds the exact failing method before broad suppression

evals.name: custom-main-runtime-test
evals.prompt: A process-isolated runtime test has a custom Main and no generated xUnit dispatch. It fails only under one target condition. Add a temporary issue-linked skip.
evals.expected_output: Use a narrowly conditioned CLRTestTargetUnsupported in the project file because xUnit ActiveIssue cannot intercept a custom Main test. Include the issue link and preserve other targets.

assertions.name: uses-target-unsupported
assertions.description: Selects the runtime-test project mechanism

assertions.name: explains-xunit-limit
assertions.description: Explains why ActiveIssue cannot apply

assertions.name: conditions-target
assertions.description: Keeps unaffected targets active

evals.name: fix-instead-of-quarantine
evals.prompt: This test exposes a straightforward product bug and I want you to fix the implementation. Please add ActiveIssue first so CI is green.
evals.expected_output: Stop the quarantine workflow because the user asked to fix the underlying product bug. Do not add ActiveIssue unless a separate decision establishes that a temporary quarantine is required.

assertions.name: stops-quarantine
assertions.description: Does not silently switch from fixing to disabling

evals.name: post-merge-issue-labels
evals.prompt: The quarantine PR merged. It disabled tests against three separate tracking issues. What issue cleanup is required?
evals.expected_output: Add disabled-test to all three referenced issues, remove clean-CI blocking labels when appropriate, and keep the product issues open as re-enable trackers.

assertions.name: labels-every-issue
assertions.description: Updates every issue represented by the merged quarantine

assertions.name: uses-disabled-test-label
assertions.description: Uses the repository's exact label

assertions.name: removes-blocking-labels
assertions.description: Removes no-longer-applicable clean-CI blockers

assertions.name: keeps-tracker-open
assertions.description: Does not treat disabling as fixing

evals.name: grep-discoverable-project-exclusion
evals.prompt: I need to conditionally set R2RIncompatible in a runtime-test csproj because the failure occurs before method dispatch. How should I reference the tracking issue so automated searches can find the disabled test?
evals.expected_output: Place an adjacent XML comment containing the literal ActiveIssue and the full dotnet/runtime issue URL immediately before the conditioned property.

assertions.name: uses-activeissue-marker
assertions.description: Includes the literal marker used by repository searches

assertions.name: uses-full-issue-url
assertions.description: Includes a full tracking issue URL rather than a bare number

assertions.name: places-comment-adjacent
assertions.description: Places the marker next to the exclusion property

evals.name: stress-mode-precedence
evals.prompt: A normal discovered runtime-test method fails only under CoreCLR GCStress. The project is currently merged and has no reason to require its own process. Should I set GCStressIncompatible and RequiresProcessIsolation?
evals.expected_output: Do not introduce process isolation. Prefer SkipOnCoreClr with the matching RuntimeTestModes GCStress value and verify ordinary CoreCLR runs remain active.

assertions.name: uses-mode-filter
assertions.description: Uses the xUnit filter that directly represents the failing mode

assertions.name: uses-runtime-test-modes
assertions.description: Scopes the skip to GCStress

assertions.name: rejects-new-isolation
assertions.description: Does not add process isolation solely for the mode skip

evals.name: umbrella-subtest
evals.prompt: One invocation inside a legacy runtime-test entry point fails in a specific mode, but the same entry point manually runs 40 other passing subtests. Add the narrowest quarantine.
evals.expected_output: Do not skip the umbrella entry point. Guard only the failing subtest invocation with the precise existing predicate, retain skipped-test reporting, and verify the other 40 invocations still run.

assertions.name: guards-single-invocation
assertions.description: Suppresses only the failing manually dispatched subtest

assertions.name: keeps-umbrella-active
assertions.description: Does not disable the outer entry point

assertions.name: validates-siblings
assertions.description: Confirms passing sibling subtests still execute
